description: Create your first GitHub repository with any preferred programming language such as Java, Python, Node.js, Angular or React.
requirements: Repository should be public or accessible from the submitted Git URL
Repository should contain a valid initialized project in Java, Python, Node.js, Angular or React
Repository should have a minimal project structure with source files
Repository should include a README.md file explaining the project purpose and setup steps
Repository should contain at least one meaningful commit after initial setup
title: Create Github Code Repo
